title: Jia de Guzman says Alas Women 'hungry for more' after morale-boosting win vs Qatar
summary: Alas Pilipinas Women's captain Jia de Guzman said Sunday that their lopsided win over Qatar definitely boosted their confidence in the classification round of the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Games.
